text: Scarce means hard to find because there is not much of something. Here the flowery meadows are scarce because most have been turned into other kinds of fields.
Parched means very dry from no rain, like a throat after a hard game. Here the meadow looks like an ordinary dry, yellowish field.
Fragmented means broken into small pieces that are separated. Here the insects' homes are cut into small patches with gaps between them, so insects get trapped.
Surrey is a county in southern England, just south of London. The meadow in this story is there.
A site of special scientific interest is a place in Britain that the law protects because it has rare plants, animals or rocks.
Chalky means made of or full of chalk, a soft white rock. The hills here have thin chalky soil, which suits many wildflowers.
The North Downs are a line of low, rolling chalk hills in southern England.
Species-rich means home to many different kinds of living things. A species-rich meadow has lots of different flowers and insects.
Grassland is land mostly covered in grass and wildflowers instead of trees.
Herbs here means small soft-stemmed plants, including wildflowers, not just the kind you cook with.
Vetch is a wild plant with small purple flowers that climbs on other plants. Many insects visit it for nectar.
A rufous grasshopper is a grasshopper with a reddish-brown colour. Rufous means red-brown.
The adonis blue is a small, bright blue butterfly that is rare in Britain and likes chalky meadows.
A kestrel is a small bird of prey that hovers in the air while it looks for mice to catch.
Hovers means stays in one place in the air, like a helicopter. The kestrel flaps and hovers while it searches the ground.
Vanished means disappeared completely. More than 97% of the flowery grassland has vanished.
A monoculture is a huge area where only one kind of plant grows. Mono means one.
Anathema is a formal word for something you strongly dislike or that is very bad for something. Here one-kind grass is anathema to insects, meaning it is terrible for them.
Livestock means farm animals such as cows and sheep.
Synthetic pesticides are chemicals made by people to kill pests. They can also harm helpful insects.
To pollinate is to carry pollen from one flower to another so plants can make seeds and fruit. Bees do this.
Dung is animal poop. Insects such as dung beetles break it down and return it to the soil.
Pests are animals or insects that harm crops. Some insects eat other insects and keep pests under control.
To keep something at bay means to hold it back so it cannot cause harm.
A spiral of doom is a problem that keeps getting worse, because each bad step causes the next one.
To reproduce is to have babies, or for plants and animals to make more of their own kind.
Buglife is a charity in Britain that works to protect insects and other small animals.
B-lines are planned paths of flowers across Britain that let bees and other insects travel from one habitat to another.
A hectare is a measure of land. It is about the size of a big sports field, or roughly two and a half acres.
Pollinators are the animals, mostly insects, that carry pollen between flowers.
The sea-aster mining bee is a rare bee that digs its nest in the ground and feeds on sea-aster flowers by the coast.
The wormwood moonshiner is a rare beetle that lives on sandy ground and eats wormwood plants.
Churchyards are the grassy grounds around churches. Left wild, they can become small meadows.
Citizen scientists are ordinary people who help scientists collect information, such as counting plants and insects.
Flora means plants and fauna means animals. Together they mean all the wildlife in a place.
Satellites are machines that orbit Earth and take pictures from space.
A machine-learning model is a computer program that learns patterns from lots of examples and then makes predictions, such as telling what type of grass is in a picture.
Rolled out means made available for people to use after being tested.
This is a pun on going from A to B, meaning travelling from one place to another. Bee is the insect.
